data.long_meaning: The name Sharwanisha is derived from the Sanskrit words Sharva, which means 'God of Prosperity', and Ishani, which means 'Goddess of Strength'. This beautiful name signifies the embodiment of Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, who is often depicted holding a lotus flower in her hands. The name Sharwanisha carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwanisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
